primary_hypothesis: Semantic Causal Consistency (SCC = CECA × weighted CPS) on question-critical visual evidence across meaning-preserving image variants predicts answer failure under held-out disjoint transformation families significantly better than behavioral consistency, confidence, entropy, and external necessity baselines.
primary_research_question: Among multimodal VQA instances whose prediction remains correct and behaviorally invariant across reviewed meaning-preserving image changes, does internal causal mediator stability collapse, and does joint external-internal pathway measurement (SCC) predict held-out generalization failure beyond existing baselines?

failure_definition.eligible_subset: Baseline-correct items only (baseline VQA consensus score >= 0.5)
failure_definition.failure_criterion: VQA consensus score < 0.5 on at least one held-out approved variant
failure_definition.secondary_failure_criterion: Answer flip (prediction differs from baseline prediction)
failure_definition.heldout_scope: Transformation-family generalization on disjoint reviewed family; not general OOD or unconstrained hallucination

dataset_sampling_and_splits.leakage_rule: Strict zero leakage. All variants, masks, controls, questions, and model evaluations for an image belong exclusively to one split partition.
dataset_sampling_and_splits.evaluation_sequence: Fit predictors / calibrate thresholds strictly on train; validate on validation; lock test partition and evaluate test strictly once.

variant_protocol.disjointness_rule: Probe (photometric) and heldout (geometric) families must be strictly disjoint.
rejection_criteria: Critical evidence degraded, obscured, or blurred beyond recognizability
Semantic relations between question entities altered or severed
Critical visual evidence truncated by image boundary shifts
Pixel compression or clipping artifacts degrading fine attributes
variant_protocol.review_audit: Record all candidate variants generated, acceptance counts, rejection counts, and specific rejection reasons in variant_rejection_audit.json and variant_review.csv.

evidence_and_controls_protocol.evidence_proposal: Grounded critical evidence masks proposed via Grounding DINO + SAM2 on question-critical entities.
evidence_and_controls_protocol.evidence_review: Every evidence mask must be reviewed, verified for exact entity coverage, and signed off with reviewer and date.
evidence_and_controls_protocol.control_masks_generation: Translated non-overlapping spatial controls matching the area and shape of the critical evidence mask.
evidence_and_controls_protocol.control_review: Every spatial control mask reviewed and verified to cover background context without overlapping critical evidence.

candidate_answers_protocol.rule: Preregister closed-world candidate answer bins before model inference without consulting gold answers or model predictions.
candidate_answers_protocol.bin_count: At least 2 bins; typically 4-12 task-relevant bins plus an explicit 'other' distractor bin.
candidate_answers_protocol.audit: Record bins, reviewer, and review date in candidate_answer_review.csv.

statistical_evaluation_and_baselines.confidence_interval_method: Grouped non-parametric bootstrap (1,000 resamples) clustered at image level; 95% percentile confidence intervals.
baseline_comparisons: external_necessity (JS divergence between factual and ablated distributions)

exclusions_and_missing_data.baseline_incorrect: Excluded from failure prediction analysis (failure is undefined if model already failed on clean image); evaluated separately for overall accuracy.
exclusions_and_missing_data.missing_mediators: If intervention effect < 0.01, mediator set is empty, CPS=1.0, CECA=1.0, SCC=1.0.
exclusions_and_missing_data.undefined_metrics: Instances where distributions are degenerate are audited and excluded from ratio metrics with explicit logging.
